Privacy Policy

Local first, clearly explained.

Effective September 21, 2026. Feature availability was clarified on November 2, 2026; the data-collection scope is unchanged. Applies to NanaFlow for the Mac App Store, versions 1.0 and 1.0.1.

What we don't collect

NanaFlow requires no account, contains no advertising or third-party analytics SDKs, and does not upload focus history to servers operated by NanaFlow.

Data stored on your device

Timer settings, session history, and display preferences stay on your Mac. The main app and Widget share only the necessary local state through Apple's App Group container.

Notifications

If you allow notifications, NanaFlow uses local macOS notifications to tell you when a focus or break session ends. You can disable them in NanaFlow or System Settings.

File access and backups

The Mac App Store version currently has no interface for browsing session history, exporting backups, or importing a restore file. Session data used for statistics and settings stay on your Mac.

Contact

For privacy questions, contact the maintainers through NanaFlow GitHub Issues. Do not attach a full backup containing private session titles to a public issue.
